title: The Moon Drops By Nancy's Mountain
skyStory: The waning crescent slips into Capricorn, Nancy's own sign, and knocks politely on the mountain door with a casserole of starlight. Saturn answers in slippers. Meanwhile, somewhere down on Earth, a groundhog is being asked to forecast the weather, and the moon finds this hilarious. It has been watching winter for four billion years and still cannot predict it.

reading: It is Groundhog Day, and you will feel like you have lived this morning before. Same coffee, same window, same snowbank that refuses to move. Shake it up. Take a different route, sit in a different chair, put your socks on in the opposite order. The Tiger hates a rut.

Around 1:40 pm a small task will come back that you thought was finished. Do not growl at it. Fix it with the cheerful air of someone who has nowhere else to be. The [[Six of Pentacles]] notices how gracefully you take a redo, and it is quietly giving you points.
joel.mission: Change one tiny morning habit today, like which hand holds your mug, and notice if the day feels newer.
joel.omen: A shadow on the snow shaped like a rabbit. Six more weeks of winter, but six more weeks of good ideas too.

reading: The moon has come home to your sign, and it wants to sit at your kitchen table and hear a story. Any story. You are the storyteller, and today your hands will dance so much that someone across the room will start nodding along without hearing a word.

Saturn, your ruler, is in an unusually generous mood. It hands you a small block of quiet time around mid-afternoon. Use it for something only you would think of. The [[Six of Swords]] glides past in the corner of your eye, boat steady, oars resting. The crossing is going better than you think.
nancy.mission: Tell someone the story of your favourite winter morning, with full hand choreography.
nancy.omen: Your reflection in a dark window catching you mid-smile. The moon in your sign is approving of the plan.

together.text: Send each other one weather forecast today, completely made up and extremely specific. Snow shaped like question marks at 4 pm. Sunshine that smells faintly of cinnamon. Whoever predicts the silliest weather gets to be the official groundhog until next year.

game.intro: The moon drops by Nancy's mountain and a groundhog drops by the studio. Pick your forecast, guess theirs.
game.question: A groundhog pops up and offers you a forecast. Which one are you hoping for?
